I can't check this against the repository, so what follows is my best recollection of Dispatch, not something I've verified. Treat the four lines at the end as a guess to confirm in the code.

As I remember it, the snooze flow in the Slack plugin creates an MFA challenge that points to a Dispatch web UI page. The Slack handler then polls that challenge until the user approves it or the wait runs out. I believe the wait is about 5 minutes. If the user never approves, I believe the challenge ends up `expired` rather than `denied`, since `denied` would mean the user actively rejected it.

I'm unsure of the exact function name and file. The Slack case interactive handlers are my best guess for where it lives. To confirm, search for the MFA challenge status enum (values like pending, approved, expired) and for the polling loop that checks the challenge status.

FILE: src/dispatch/plugins/dispatch_slack/case/interactive.py
FUNCTION: handle_snooze_preview_event
TIMEOUT: 5 minutes
END_STATUS: expired
